title: Davtashen Bridge
visualBrief: The complete mapped Yerevan gorge crossing: yellow steel box girders, four paired tall concrete pier stations, shallow approach viaducts, a broad six-lane road, two sidewalks, open white rails and inward-reaching lamps.
nativeAxes: +X southeast to Arabkir; -X northwest to Davtashen. +Z southwest. +Y up. Source ground reference is the lowest exposed foundation; exact foundations are inferred.
sourceFacts: Retained catalog facts: 496 m length, 32 m width and nominal 92 m height; absolute height datum is unresolved.
Exact-QID OSM bridge footprint measures approximately 497.033 × 31.985 m.
Ordinary 2025/older photographs show four paired tall concrete supports, yellow girders, white road furniture and shorter concrete approach spans.
reconstruction: Original source-local analytic geometry; no downloaded meshes or photo textures.
Five main spans interpreted as 47.8 + 80 + 80 + 80 + 64 m, with remaining approach length split equally. Pier feet, member sections and end schedule remain approximate.
Master retains dense girder stiffeners and rail posts; four separate browser levels reduce repeats while retaining the complete bridge.
